I have decrypted the WAL file and recovered all 11 records into `/app/recovered.json`:

1. **WAL File Repair**: Inspection of [main.db-wal](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-kzy4llwp/main.db-wal) showed that every byte was XOR-encoded with `0x42` (turning the SQLite WAL header magic `0x377f0682` into `0x753d44c0` and `0x00` bytes into `0x42`). XORing the file with `0x42` restored the valid SQLite WAL header and all 4 frames.
2. **Database & WAL Recovery**: With [main.db-wal](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-kzy4llwp/main.db-wal) restored and [main.db](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-kzy4llwp/main.db) updated, all 11 records in the `items` table (including updated values for `id` 1 and 2, and inserted records `id` 6 through 11) are accessible.
3. **Extracted Output**: Wrote all 11 records sorted by `id` to [recovered.json](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-kzy4llwp/recovered.json).
